title: Degeneralize Hardcoded S App Identity From Os Shell
description: V3 (Wave-4 coupling auditor) flagged framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx and framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs for hardcoding the "s" app's identity (S_HOME_APP_ID/S_PLAY_APP_ID/S_PLAY_CONTROLLER_ID/S_HOME_CONTROLLER_ID/S_PLAY_CATALOGUE_TAB_ID, isStudioMode()==="s", switchToSApp) directly in generic shell control flow (switchToSApp/goHome, studio-mode detection, action routing for spawnApp/undo/redo/closeFocusedInstance/presenceHeartbeat/importStudio). Replace these with a small generic PluginHostConfig lookup (pluginId -> landingAppId/hostAppId) mirrored in framework/core/js/index.ts (TS) and framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs's plugin_bridge module (Rust), with controller ids and default panel-tab ids derived from the resolved apps' own manifest data (controllerId, panelTabs[0]) instead of separate literal constants. s/plugin/rs is out of scope (already SDK-migrated).
summary: Removed the hardcoded "s" app identity (S_HOME_APP_ID/S_PLAY_APP_ID/S_PLAY_CONTROLLER_ID/S_HOME_CONTROLLER_ID/S_PLAY_CATALOGUE_TAB_ID constants, isStudioMode()==="s", switchToSApp/switch_to_s_app, is_studio_mode(plugin_filter)=="s") from the generic os-shell renderers. Added a tiny PluginHostConfig lookup (pluginId -> landingAppId/hostAppId) mirrored in framework/core/js/index.ts (resolvePluginHostConfig, reusing the existing resolvePluginRegistryId/resolvePlaygroundDefaultAppId alias-resolution pattern) and framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs's plugin_bridge module (PluginHostConfig/resolve_plugin_host_config), with a single "s"->home/studio entry. Every controller id and default/catalogue panel-tab id the shell previously hardcoded is now derived at the call site from the resolved app's own self-declared controllerId/panelTabs (or from session.app.controllerId when the guard already confirms session.app is the host/landing app) instead of separate literals. switchToSApp/switch_to_s_app renamed to switchToManagedApp/switch_to_managed_app and parameterized by resolved app id. Two now-provably-redundant literal comparisons (panelTabIcon/panel_tab_icon_id's tabId===catalogueTabId, already covered by group==="workbench"/PanelGroup::Workbench) were deleted rather than parameterized. s/plugin/rs (SHomeApp/SStudioApp) was not touched — its own S_HOME_APP_ID/S_PLAY_APP_ID/etc. constants are legitimate internal plugin implementation details, out of scope per the ticket. Verified: TS side via tsc --noEmit diffed against a pre-edit baseline run (74 pre-existing repo-wide errors unchanged, the one error introduced by an interim panelTabs[0].id typo was caught and fixed, zero errors on any touched line after the fix) since the repo's vitest suite for framework/renderer/react and framework/core could not run in this session (missing pre-built wasm pkg artifact for framework/renderer/react; bun/cargo file-lock contention from concurrent sessions for framework/core and the wgpu cargo check, confirmed by an unrelated concurrent `cargo check -p os-hub-storage-postgres` process observed mid-session) — both are environment/concurrency issues unrelated to this change, not introduced by it. Rust side verified via: brace-balance sanity (5201/5201 balanced), an isolated diff against a pre-edit snapshot of lib.rs (255 lines, exactly the intended edits, no interference from concurrent unrelated dock-drag work also landing in this file), and manual borrow-checker/NLL reasoning at every &mut self call site touched (two sites were restructured — studio.canvas.back and select_left_panel_tab — to compute owned values before the mutable dispatch_action call rather than relying on nested-borrow NLL inference, for safety without compiler confirmation). rustfmt --check was not usable as a signal (the whole file diverges from default rustfmt output under this repo's own rustfmt.toml, unrelated to this change). A full cargo check --workspace was not completed in this session (contended) and is left for the orchestrator's final gate per the stated verification policy. One intentional behavior tweak: the studio-mode boot-time title fallback ("semio · s · studio", shown only before any session has loaded) is now generic ("semio · {plugin_filter}") instead of hardcoding the S product's display name.
